resources.string: Paste the pairing key or pairing link from DSH
Invalid pairing information\nThe key or link is malformed or belongs to another computer. Generate it again on the computer and paste it in full.
Pairing failed\nThe QR code may be expired or already used, or the computer may be unreachable. Check the connection, generate a new QR code, and try it immediately.
Computer identity could not be verified\nThe address is unreachable or its certificate does not match the QR code. Confirm this is the same computer and generate a new QR code.
Point the camera at the QR code on the computer screen.
Camera unavailable\nAnother app may be using it, or this device may not support it. Close other camera apps or paste the pairing link instead.
QR scanning unavailable\nCamera permission was not granted. Allow camera access or paste the pairing link instead.
Invalid QR code\nNo DSH pairing link was recognized. Generate a new QR code on the computer and confirm that the app and plugin are current.
Invalid address\nA valid HTTPS address or port is missing. Enter the complete address shown on the computer, such as https://192.168.1.20:3443.
This removes the encrypted device credential, saved address, cookies, cache, and WebView storage from this app.
The certificate does not match the saved computer identity. Confirm that this is the correct computer. If it was reinstalled or its certificate was reset, clear site data and pair again.
DSH may not be running, or a firewall or the current network may block the connection. Test the computer address in the phone browser; if it is unreachable, try a phone hotspot.
Navigation blocked\nThe target is not HTTPS or was not opened by you. Open only trusted HTTPS links.
Link could not be opened\nNo system browser is available. Install or enable a browser and try again.
Download blocked\nThe file is not from the currently connected DSH. Download only files provided by this DSH.
Download failed\nThe file may no longer be available or the network was interrupted. Check the connection and try again.
